spa_react.html.notes: React SPA shell: title + viewport exist, but no meta description, no headings, no canonical, no JSON-LD, and no main landmark. LANG001/META001 must be absent because lang=en and <title> are present.

spa_vue.html.notes: Vue SPA intentionally ships without <title>, meta description, or html lang — all three omissions must be detected. Viewport exists, so MOB001 must not fire.

ecommerce_product.html.notes: Complete Product schema inside an @graph wrapper (no root @type), with valid Offer and aggregateRating. OFFER001 (offer error) must NOT fire; SD001 must NOT fire because JSON-LD exists; SD004 must NOT fire because @graph entries carry @type. CANCON003 must NOT fire because the harness serves the page from its canonical URL.

blog_post.html.notes: 2000+ word article with BlogPosting JSON-LD: content-rich page must not trigger THIN002; has nav landmark but no skip link, so A11Y008 and SKIPLINK001 must both fire.

corporate_about.html.notes: Organization schema present (so no SD001); all images have alt text; meta description exists. Skip-link omissions (A11Y008 + SKIPLINK001) are the archetype's known gap.

security_heavy.html.notes: Security-meta page with a WebAuthn demo form. Its fieldset checkboxes use implicit <label><input> nesting and its hidden CSRF inputs never need accessible names, so none of the unlabeled-input codes (FLABEL001/A11Y011/FORMLAB001) may fire. No JSON-LD, but description exists and all resources are HTTPS.

multi_language.html.notes: Reciprocal hreflang cluster (fr/en/de/es + x-default) with html lang=fr matching the fr hreflang: all hreflang-error and content-language-mismatch codes must be absent.

accessibility_focused.html.notes: Exemplary accessibility page: skip link, main landmark, headings, labeled inputs, alt text. The core assertion is the ABSENCE of every basic a11y error code. TABINDEX002 must NOT fire: the main landmark's tabindex=-1 is a valid, intentional skip-link target pattern.

minimal_landing.html.notes: Intentionally thin landing page: no description, no headings, no canonical, no viewport, under 100 words. HTTP-only-resource codes must be absent (single HTTPS external link).

error_404_content.html.notes: Soft 404: error-page content served as 200. HTTP007 (soft-404 detection) and ROBOTS001 (noindex meta) are the archetype's defining findings.

dark_mode_heavy.html.notes: Style-block-heavy dark theme page. Validates that extensive CSS does not corrupt text extraction: meta description intact, word count above thin threshold, no HTTP resources.

schema_rich.html.notes: Five JSON-LD blocks (LocalBusiness, WebSite+SearchAction, BreadcrumbList, FAQPage, VideoObject). SCNEST001 confirms nested-schema detection; SD001 must be absent.

redirect_chain.html.notes: Meta refresh + cross-domain canonical + single hreflang without x-default: HREF001/HREFXD001 must fire while HREFMISS001 (no hreflang at all) must not.

media_heavy.html.notes: 34 images (two without alt, gif/bmp/data-URI mix, many lazy) plus blocking scripts: IMG001, IMG003, IMG005, ASYNC001, and SCRIPT002 must all fire.

pagination_page.html.notes: Page 2 of 5 with rel=prev/next and self canonical: 118-char description triggers META005 (too short), 62-char title triggers TITLE002; content is substantive enough to avoid THIN002.

mixed_content.html.notes: HTTPS page URL with HTTP script/style/image/iframe/form-action resources: the full mixed-content family (MIXED001 plus per-resource-type codes) must fire. ROBOTS001 must NOT fire: the page is a /login utility page where noindex is intentional. The hidden CSRF input and explicitly labeled inputs must not fire unlabeled-input codes.

amp_page.html.notes: AMP recipe page with Recipe JSON-LD missing nutrition info (RNUT001). Boilerplate and amp-img tags must not break description extraction or word counting.

empty_page.html.notes: Bare <html><head><title></title></head><body></body></html>: empty title must be treated as missing (META001 + TITLEMISS001), no lang attribute, no headings, no JSON-LD.

unicode_heavy.html.notes: CJK/RTL/emoji content with html lang=zh-Hans but no matching zh hreflang: CLANG001 must fire. Analysers must handle multibyte text without crashing or missing the description.

iframe_heavy.html.notes: Eight iframes (YouTube, Google Maps, same-origin) dominate the page: iframe content must NOT be counted as page text, keeping the word count in thin-content territory.
